name: Range day: fade a close beyond VWAP ± 1.5 SD
why: On a range day (no straight fortnight, choppy morning) nobody is repositioning; a stretch beyond the VWAP band is liquidity-seeking, and the market makers who absorbed it lean it back toward value. Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_range_day_mr.md).
